name: experiment-design
title_zh: A/B 测试开工前先替你算好样本量和停手时机的实验设
tagline_zh: 别等跑完两周才发现样本不够、误报爆表。它把随机化、功效、护栏和停止规则一次算清，还顺手挑出你方案里的隐蔽漏洞。
tagline_en: Don't discover low power or guardrail breaches after two weeks. It pre-checks randomization, power, guardrails.
desc_en: Design or vet an A/B test, including power, randomization, guardrails, and stopping rules.
why_zh: 不是泛泛给建议，而是按你的指标分布、最小效应量和流量预算，实算功效曲线与停止边界。
why_en: Not generic advice—it computes power curves and stopping boundaries from your metric, MDE, and traffic budget, turning 'feels.
limit_zh: 只覆盖经典频率派 A/B 检验（两臂或双臂以上），不做序贯贝叶斯、不做 MAB 或多臂老虎机。
limit_en: Frequentist A/B tests only (2+ arms); no sequential Bayes or MAB. Needs historical mean/variance or gives conservative estimates. Outputs design.
title_en: A/B test designer that pre-checks power, guardrails, and.
